import csv
ts = "25fbd76f-2635-56e8-8e9d-b1bc16e7f04a"
vals = []
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        if row["timeseries_id"] == ts and row["timestamp"].startswith("2018-01-13"):
            vals.append((row["timestamp"], float(row["value"])))
vals.sort()
print(len(vals))
print(vals[:3], vals[-3:])
mean = sum(v for _, v in vals) / len(vals)
print("mean", mean)
